description_en: Binds a custom domain name to a private gateway
description_zh: 私有网关绑定自定义域名
kebab_example: aliyun eas attach-gateway-domain --cluster-id cn-shanghai --gateway-id gw-1uhcqmsc7x22000000 --custom-domain Type=intranet CertificateId=14730025 Domain=test.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachGatewayDomain

parameters.description_en: The region where the private gateway resides.
parameters.help_en: The region where the private gateway resides
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the private gateway. To obtain the private gateway ID, see the GatewayId parameter in the response parameters of the [ListGateway](https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ\&ampEnv=online) operation.
parameters.description_zh: 私有网关ID。如何获取私有网关ID，请参见接口[ListGateway](https://apiworkbench.aliyun-inc.com/document/eas/2021-07-01/ListGateway?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.765e281fL2IcjJ&ampEnv=online)返回结果中的GatewayId字段。
